name: Responsive Viewer
summary: Renders the page inside preset device frames (desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile) with custom dimensions, rotation and a pixel-grid overlay for responsive checks.
browsersNote: Edge store has a same-name listing; author match unconfirmed; no Firefox listing found.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Previewing a page inside device frames and custom viewport sizes.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: responsive viewport device frames mobile tablet pixel grid test
